projects.title: Workforce Ultimate
projects.description: Modern, high-performance enterprise workforce, project management, and organizational collaboration platform inspired by Jira, ClickUp, and Linear. Built with Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React 19, and Supabase.
projects.fullDescription:
Workforce Ultimate is a modern, high-performance enterprise workforce, project management, and organizational collaboration platform inspired by Jira, ClickUp, and Linear. Built on Next.js 16 (App Router & Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, and Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS & Realtime), it delivers an enterprise-grade suite structured across four evolutionary phases:

• Phase 1 — Foundation & Core Architecture: Sub-second page compilation with Turbopack and dynamic streaming SSR; secure Supabase authentication with session persistence; native English and Arabic bilingual localization (i18n) with dynamic RTL layout switching; and seamless dark/light mode toggling.

• Phase 2 — Core MVP & Workforce Hierarchy: Granular 5-tier Role-Based Access Control (Owner, Admin, HR, Managers, and Employees); workspace invitation system with single-use/multi-use invite codes and 1-click joining; company timezone auto-detection and custom branding; comprehensive project & task pipelines (todo, in_progress, review, done); and estimated vs. actual labor time tracking with approval workflows.

• Phase 2.5 — Essential Operations Hub: End-of-day daily work logs (hours, blockers, mood ratings); performance evaluations with company OKRs and employee goal cycles; in-app and email real-time event notifications; instant universal search; and interactive operations analytics.

• Phase 3 — Real-Time Collaboration: Multi-tier real-time chat with public channels, private coworker channels, leadership management channels, and 1:1 direct messages; dynamic sender identities with role badges; Supabase Storage attachments and threaded comments; company audit trail logs; HR bonus/disciplinary tracking; and integration webhooks (GitHub commit sync, Gmail).

• Phase 4 — Scale & Polish: Full Progressive Web App (PWA) with desktop/mobile installability, Service Worker app-shell offline caching, and Web Push notifications; multi-tier TanStack Query caching presets and offline mutation queue; asynchronous background jobs engine; and executive workforce reporting with 1-click CSV exports and printable PDF reports.
projects.challenges: Architected a strict 5-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with Supabase PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) policies and real-time multi-channel communication across public, private, and leadership channels., Engineered a multi-tier TanStack Query caching system with a Service Worker offline queue and Web Push notifications, delivering resilient PWA offline capability and slashing redundant queries., Delivered full bidirectional (RTL/LTR) Arabic/English localization with automatic timezone detection and an executive reporting engine with 1-click CSV export and PDF printing.

projects.title: Dahlan Law Firm
projects.description: Bilingual corporate website for a premier law and legal consultations firm in Saudi Arabia, engineered with custom responsive architecture and localized Arabic/English interfaces.
projects.fullDescription: Dahlan Law Firm is an official corporate website for a distinguished law and legal consultancy firm based in Saudi Arabia (KSA). Delivered with precision using WordPress, Astra Theme, and responsive layout systems, the platform reflects institutional credibility and trust. Key deliverables include complete bilingual functionality (Arabic RTL and English LTR), comprehensive practice areas and services directory, client consultation inquiry forms, and optimized loading speeds across both desktop and mobile devices.
challenges: Developing a fully bilingual (Arabic RTL / English LTR) layout adhering to Saudi corporate legal branding standards.
Structuring multi-tier legal consultation practice areas and attorney profiles with intuitive navigation.
Optimizing typography and media asset delivery (Alexandria Arabic font) for low latency across the GCC.
Ensuring pixel-perfect responsiveness and fast performance across all screen sizes and browsers.

projects.title: Nest Next Store
projects.description: Full-Stack Headless E-Commerce Platform architected with Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM.
projects.fullDescription: Nest Next Store is a high-performance headless e-commerce platform built with Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. It features a modern decoupled architecture that manages product catalogs, shopping carts, coupons, wishlists, and a dynamic checkout experience. The backend services are built with modular NestJS patterns and Prisma ORM, leveraging relational database schema constraints to improve query performance by 30%.
projects.challenges: Architected decoupled e-commerce architecture managing product catalogs, shopping carts, coupons, wishlist, and dynamic checkout., Designed modular NestJS backend services with Prisma ORM and relational schema constraints, improving database query efficiency by 30%.

projects.title: The Wild Oasis
projects.description: A hotel operations dashboard for managing cabins, bookings, guests, check-ins, and daily business activity from one place.
projects.fullDescription: The Wild Oasis is a hotel operations dashboard designed for staff to manage daily business activities efficiently from a single interface. It provides a centralized system for handling cabins, bookings, guests, check-ins, check-outs, and account settings. The application is built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite, using Supabase as the backend service for authentication and data management. It features secure authentication with protected routes, a dashboard with business metrics and charts, and full CRUD functionality for cabins and bookings. The system also includes guest management workflows, real-time booking operations, and customizable account settings with dark mode support. The project is structured using a feature-based architecture, separating domain logic, UI components, services, hooks, and context providers to ensure scalability and maintainability.
challenges: Designing a feature-based architecture that keeps complex domains like bookings, cabins, and guests isolated yet reusable.
Managing authentication and route protection securely using Supabase while maintaining a smooth user experience.
Handling synchronized state between React Query cache and Supabase backend without data inconsistencies.
Building a clean and scalable UI system for dashboards, tables, and forms with reusable components.
Implementing real-time-like updates for bookings and check-in/check-out workflows while preserving performance.

projects.title: Fast React Pizza
projects.description: A React-based pizza ordering application demonstrating routing, state management, and dynamic UI interactions.
projects.fullDescription: Fast React Pizza is a frontend application built while learning React, focusing on core concepts such as routing, global state management, and component-based architecture. The app allows users to browse a menu, add items to a cart, and place orders through a smooth and interactive UI. It uses React Router for navigation and Redux for managing global state like the shopping cart and order data. The project emphasizes clean component structure, predictable state flow, and reusable UI patterns, making it a strong foundation for building scalable React applications.
challenges: Understanding and implementing global state management using Redux.
Structuring components for scalability and reusability.
Managing navigation and dynamic routes using React Router.
Handling user interactions like cart updates and order flow smoothly.

projects.title: QR Code Generator
projects.description: A customizable QR code generator with advanced styling options, built as a cross-platform web application.
projects.fullDescription: QR Code Generator is a modern web application that allows users to create fully customizable QR codes with advanced styling and configuration options. Users can modify colors, shapes, patterns, and embedded elements to generate visually unique QR codes tailored to their needs. The application is built using React 19 and TypeScript, with a strong focus on UI/UX and component reusability. It leverages Tailwind CSS and Radix UI for building accessible and flexible interfaces, and React Hook Form for handling complex form interactions. The app is designed to run seamlessly across web platforms including Windows and Linux, providing a consistent cross-platform experience. Additional UI enhancements such as charts, notifications, and responsive layouts ensure a smooth and interactive user journey.
challenges: Building a highly dynamic form system to support multiple QR customization options.
Managing complex UI states while keeping the interface responsive and intuitive.
Integrating QR generation libraries with custom styling controls.
Ensuring cross-platform compatibility across different operating systems and browsers.
Maintaining clean and scalable component structure with many interactive UI elements.

projects.title: Popcorn Movies
projects.description: A movie search and watchlist application with API integration, rating system, and local storage persistence.
projects.fullDescription: Popcorn Movies is a React-based application built to practice API integration, state management, and data persistence. The app allows users to search for movies and series using the OMDb API, view details, and manage a personalized watchlist. Users can mark items as watched, rate them, and store their selections using localStorage, ensuring data persists across sessions. The project focuses on building interactive UI components, handling asynchronous API requests, and managing user-driven data flows in a clean and structured way.
challenges: Handling asynchronous API requests and managing loading and error states.
Designing a smooth user experience for searching and selecting movies.
Persisting user data using localStorage without breaking state consistency.
Managing component state for ratings, watched list, and selections.
Ensuring responsive UI updates when interacting with external API data.

projects.title: Ashtry Meny
projects.description: End-to-end multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace featuring a cross-platform Flutter mobile application and a scalable Django REST Framework backend.
projects.fullDescription: Ashtray Meny is a fullstack e-commerce platform combining a Django REST Framework backend with a Flutter mobile application. The backend provides a scalable API for managing users, products, shops, categories, orders, and reviews, while the Flutter frontend delivers a responsive and smooth mobile experience. The system uses JWT-based authentication and role-based access control to support multiple user roles including admins, shop owners, and customers. On the mobile side, Provider is used for state management, Dio for API communication, and Shared Preferences for local persistence. The platform supports product browsing, filtering, order management, wishlist functionality, and a review system. It also includes Swagger API documentation using drf-spectacular. The project is containerized using Docker and integrates GitHub Actions for automated workflows, reflecting a production-oriented and DevOps-aware architecture.
challenges: Developed an end-to-end multi-vendor marketplace featuring a cross-platform mobile application and a scalable Django REST backend.
Configured secure JWT authentication, vendor management, and isolated local development environments using Docker.

projects.title: Recipe App API
projects.description: A RESTful API for managing recipes, built with Django and Django REST Framework to practice backend development fundamentals.
projects.fullDescription: Recipe App API is a backend project built while learning Django and Django REST Framework, focusing on core backend development concepts. The API provides endpoints for managing recipes, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting data. It demonstrates the implementation of RESTful principles, database modeling, and API structure using Django. PostgreSQL is used as the database, and the project emphasizes clean code organization, serializers, and view logic. This project serves as a foundation for understanding how to build scalable backend services and APIs.
challenges: Understanding Django project structure and application separation.
Designing database models and relationships for recipe data.
Implementing RESTful endpoints using Django REST Framework.
Handling serialization and validation of incoming data.
Connecting the backend with PostgreSQL and managing migrations.

projects.title: SecureChat
projects.description: A real-time chat application built with Flutter and Firebase, featuring authentication and persistent messaging.
projects.fullDescription: SecureChat is a real-time chat application built using Flutter and Firebase services. It enables users to register, authenticate, and exchange messages instantly through a responsive mobile interface. The app uses Firebase Authentication for secure user login and Cloud Firestore for real-time data synchronization, allowing messages to be sent and received instantly. Provider is used for state management, while Shared Preferences is utilized for local data persistence. The project focuses on building a smooth messaging experience with clean UI design, efficient state handling, and scalable real-time communication architecture.
challenges: Implementing real-time messaging using Cloud Firestore.
Managing authentication flows securely with Firebase Authentication.
Handling state management efficiently using Provider.
Ensuring message synchronization across users without delays.
Maintaining performance and responsiveness in a real-time chat environment.

projects.title: FunFacts
projects.description: A Flutter application that displays random fun facts, built to practice API handling, state management, and UI development.
projects.fullDescription: FunFacts is a Flutter learning project designed to practice core mobile development concepts including API integration, state management, and persistent storage. The application fetches random facts from an external API and displays them in a simple and responsive UI. It uses Dio for handling HTTP requests, Provider for state management, and Shared Preferences for storing user preferences locally. The project focuses on understanding Flutter architecture, managing asynchronous data flow, and building clean UI components.
challenges: Handling asynchronous API requests and managing loading states.
Structuring Flutter state management using Provider.
Ensuring smooth UI updates when fetching remote data.
Persisting user preferences using Shared Preferences.
Building a clean and simple UI while learning Flutter fundamentals.

projects.title: BucketList
projects.description: A Flutter application for managing personal goals and bucket list items, built to practice CRUD operations and API handling.
projects.fullDescription: BucketList is a Flutter learning project designed to practice core mobile development concepts such as CRUD operations, API communication, and basic state handling. The application allows users to create, view, update, and delete bucket list items, helping reinforce understanding of data flow in Flutter applications. Dio is used for handling HTTP requests, and the project focuses on building clean UI components and managing application state effectively while keeping the architecture simple and maintainable.
challenges: Implementing full CRUD operations in a Flutter application.
Handling API requests and managing asynchronous data flow.
Maintaining UI state consistency during create, update, and delete actions.
Structuring a simple but scalable Flutter project architecture.
Improving understanding of client-server communication basics.

projects.title: Todo App Flutter
projects.description: A Flutter-based task management application with persistent storage and utility integrations.
projects.fullDescription: Todo App Flutter is a simple task management application built to practice Flutter fundamentals including state management, local persistence, and UI development. The app allows users to create, update, and delete tasks while storing data locally using Shared Preferences. It also integrates URL Launcher for external actions and uses Material Design Icons for enhanced UI experience. The project focuses on building a clean and responsive interface while reinforcing core Flutter development concepts such as widget composition, state handling, and local data storage.
challenges: Implementing persistent local storage using Shared Preferences.
Managing application state for task creation, updates, and deletion.
Ensuring UI consistency between saved and active task states.
Integrating external actions using URL Launcher.
Building a clean and intuitive UI with reusable Flutter widgets.

projects.fullDescription: Billionaire App is a Flutter learning project created to practice core mobile development concepts such as UI building, state management, and local persistence. The application focuses on building interactive screens and managing simple user data using Shared Preferences. It helps reinforce Flutter fundamentals including widget composition, layout design, and basic state handling in a clean and structured way.
challenges: Building responsive UI layouts using Flutter widgets.
Managing simple application state across screens.
Persisting user data locally using Shared Preferences.
Improving understanding of Flutter widget lifecycle and structure.
Practicing clean separation of UI and logic in a small project.

It focuses on understanding the basic project structure, widget tree, and how a Flutter application is initialized and rendered. The project serves as a starting point for exploring Flutter development and building more complex applications.

Learning how widgets build the UI tree.
Running and debugging a Flutter application.
Getting familiar with Dart syntax and Flutter basics.

projects.description: A front-end clone of the AirBnB platform built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to practice UI development and DOM manipulation.
projects.fullDescription: AirBnB Clone v4 is a front-end project built while learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It replicates key UI components of the AirBnB platform to practice responsive design, layout structuring, and DOM manipulation. The project focuses on building interactive user interfaces, handling dynamic content with JavaScript, and improving understanding of how real-world web applications structure their front-end architecture.

Handling dynamic UI updates using vanilla JavaScript.
Structuring components for a scalable front-end layout.
Ensuring responsive design across different screen sizes.
Simulating real-world application behavior without frameworks.

projects.title: Simple Shell
projects.description: A basic UNIX-like shell implemented in C, supporting fundamental command execution such as cd and ls.
projects.fullDescription: Simple Shell is a low-level systems programming project written in C that simulates basic behavior of a UNIX shell. It supports executing fundamental commands such as cd and ls by interacting directly with the operating system through system calls. The project was developed as a collaborative effort with a teammate, focusing on learning core concepts of process creation, command parsing, and terminal interaction. It provides hands-on experience with how shells work internally at a system level.
challenges: Understanding UNIX process creation and execution using system calls.
Parsing user input and handling command arguments correctly.
Managing child processes and command execution flow.
Handling built-in commands like cd differently from external commands.
Collaborating effectively in a team environment on a systems-level project.

projects.title: Sorting Algorithms (C)
projects.description: A C implementation of fundamental sorting algorithms built to understand algorithm design and time complexity analysis.
projects.fullDescription: Sorting Algorithms is a low-level computer science project written in C to implement and study classic sorting techniques. The project focuses on understanding how different sorting algorithms work internally, including their logic, efficiency, and time complexity behavior. It serves as a hands-on exploration of algorithmic thinking, memory management, and performance analysis in C. This project helped strengthen foundational knowledge in data structures and algorithms while improving problem-solving skills in a systems-level language.
challenges: Understanding and implementing multiple sorting algorithms from scratch in C.
Analyzing and comparing time complexity (Big-O) of different approaches.
Managing memory and array manipulation at a low level.
Translating theoretical algorithms into working C implementations.
Improving algorithmic thinking and problem decomposition skills.

projects.title: Binary Trees (C)
projects.description: A C implementation of binary tree data structures and fundamental operations such as traversal, insertion, and analysis.
projects.fullDescription: Binary Trees is a low-level data structures project written in C focused on implementing and understanding binary tree concepts. It includes building and manipulating binary tree nodes, performing different traversal methods (pre-order, in-order, post-order), and implementing core tree operations such as height calculation, size computation, and node relationships. The project strengthens understanding of recursive problem solving, memory management, and fundamental computer science data structures.
challenges: Implementing recursive tree traversal algorithms in C.
Managing dynamic memory allocation and pointer structures safely.
Understanding tree properties such as height, depth, and size.
Building reusable and modular data structure functions.
Translating theoretical binary tree concepts into working C code.

projects.title: Custom Printf (C)
projects.description: A reimplementation of the C printf function built in collaboration with a teammate to understand variadic functions and formatted output in C.
projects.fullDescription: Custom Printf is a low-level systems programming project written in C that replicates the behavior of the standard printf function. The project was developed collaboratively with a teammate to deepen understanding of variadic functions, formatted string parsing, and output handling in C. It focuses on how format specifiers are processed internally and how arguments are dynamically handled at runtime. This project provides strong insight into how core C standard library functions are implemented under the hood.
challenges: Understanding and implementing variadic functions using stdarg.h.
Parsing format strings and handling multiple specifiers correctly.
Managing different data types and their formatting output.
Ensuring correct output behavior without using standard printf.
Collaborating with a teammate on low-level C system design.

projects.title: Forkify
projects.description: A modern recipe application that allows users to search for over 1,000,000 recipes, view ingredients, adjust servings, and bookmark favorite recipes.
projects.fullDescription: Forkify is a modern recipe web application built as a learning project from Jonas Schmedtmann’s JavaScript course. The app allows users to search through more than 1,000,000 recipes, view detailed recipe information including cooking time and ingredients, and dynamically adjust ingredient quantities based on servings. Users can also bookmark favorite recipes using LocalStorage and upload their own custom recipes to the platform. The project is built using modern JavaScript (ES6+) with a modular architecture and MVC pattern to improve maintainability and scalability. It is fully responsive and optimized for a seamless experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
challenges: Understanding and implementing the MVC architecture with modular JavaScript structure.
Managing application state and dynamically updating the UI during searches and serving adjustments.
Handling asynchronous API requests and recipe data fetching efficiently.
Implementing bookmark persistence using LocalStorage.
Building a responsive UI that works smoothly across multiple screen sizes.
Learning modern JavaScript concepts such as private class fields and ES6 modules.

projects.description: An AI-powered food subscription service that delivers healthy, personalized meals year-round based on user preferences and dietary needs.
projects.fullDescription: Omnifood is a modern web project for an AI-powered food subscription service that generates fully personalized weekly meal plans. It allows users to receive diets tailored to their preferences and nutritional needs, including vegan, keto, paleo, and gluten-free options. The project features a modern, clean, and responsive UI designed for a smooth user experience across all devices. It is built using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript to handle interactions such as mobile navigation and smooth scrolling.

Structuring CSS into maintainable and scalable files.
Implementing smooth scrolling and navigation interactions.

Ensuring consistent responsive behavior across all devices and screen sizes.
